0: The model on your laptop runs, but you want to try a bigger one or do some image generation and may not have the right hardware. You can also put the compute in the cloud and let a server carry that work.
1: Cloud servers can be configured as needed. Here we keep using ModelScope Notebook: pick a CPU or GPU runtime in the browser, download the model and run the code. The page is on your own machine; the model runs on the connected cloud instance.
2: This part runs two experiments. First use the CPU to run a 0.5B-class model and judge the sentiment of a review; then use the GPU to run an image-generation model and turn a text description into an image. They show how to work with the two kinds of resource; the tasks and models differ, so you cannot compare CPU and GPU speed directly from the run time.
